# Questionnaire

> Evidence-aware Agent Skill for guided decision questionnaires.

Questionnaire helps agents run one-question-at-a-time decision interviews while keeping durable project-local artifacts: `state.json`, `transcript.md`, `CONTEXT.md`, `research/`, and `adrs/`.

The public website includes a browser-local demo. The demo can draft, autosave to `localStorage`, validate, import, and export state, but filesystem writes are agent-managed in real skill usage.

```bash
npx skills add srinitude/questionnaire
```
